Amazon's 10-K says the 2024 increase in AWS operating income was primarily due to increased sales, decreased payroll and related expenses, and a reduction in depreciation and amortization expense from its change in the estimated useful lives of its servers. Higher spending on technology infrastructure to support AWS growth partly offset these. AWS sales rose 19%, which management tied to increased customer usage, partly offset by pricing changes from long-term customer contracts. For company-wide context, consolidated operating income rose about 86.1%, from $36.85 billion to $68.59 billion, an increase of about $31.74 billion.
